image_description: A large adult bison stands on the left side of the frame, partially cropped, with its head and front legs visible. A small, light-brown bison calf is lying down in the grass to the right of the adult. The setting is a green grassy field with two pieces of driftwood or branches in the foreground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The adult bison's head is largely cut off by the top edge of the frame; horns are not clearly visible or verifiable.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The characteristic dark, shaggy beard is clearly visible on the adult bison's throat area.
The angle and cropping of the adult's head obscure the eyes; the calf's eyes are visible but small and hard to verify for color definitively at this resolution.
Ears are not distinctly visible on either the adult (cropped/obscured by fur) or the calf (blended with head fur).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The adult bison displays the massive shoulder hump and heavy build typical of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture and color of the fur on the adult's forequarters match the description perfectly.
The adult's hindquarters are outside the frame. The calf has uniform fur, which is age-appropriate but doesn't test the adult trait.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Horns are not visible due to cropping.
The visible front leg of the adult is sturdy. Hooves are partially obscured by grass but appear structurally correct.
Tails are not visible for either the adult (out of frame) or the calf (obscured by body position).

artifact_observations.reasoning: The calf's fur has a slightly overly smooth, 'airbrushed' consistency compared to the coarse texture of the adult, lacking individual strand definition, though this could be due to age/resolution.
The two wooden sticks in the foreground have ambiguous geometry; the right stick appears to merge slightly with the grass without a clear contact shadow or root point, looking somewhat 'pasted'.
The joint articulation of the visible front leg seems slightly stiff and lacks the subtle muscle definition expected in a weight-bearing limb, appearing slightly cylindrical.
